claims.text: Poltu Quatu means 'hidden port' in the local Sardinian dialect.

findings.quote: The name Poltu Quatu translates from the local Sardinian dialect as “hidden port”.

claims.text: The village sits in a natural fjord of granite cliffs and is hidden from view from the sea until you sail inside.

findings.quote: Nestled within a natural fjord of granite cliffs, the village remains hidden from view when passing the entrance from the sea, revealing itself only once you sail inside.

claims.text: Poltu Quatu Marina, a few steps from the hotel, is a departure point for the La Maddalena Archipelago national park, a short boat ride away.

findings.quote: Just a few steps from our hotel lies the charming Poltu Quatu Marina, the perfect departure point for exploring the breathtaking La Maddalena Archipelago.
With a short boat ride, you can reach this extraordinary national park

claims.text: The design uses organic forms, local materials and handcrafted touches inspired by ancient art and traditional pottery.
